sloka: द्वितीयं रावणशिरश्छिन्नं संयति सायकैः ।छिन्नमात्रं तु तच्छीर्षं पुनरन्यत् स्म दृश्यते ।। ६.११०.२८ ।।
transliteration: dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaśiraśchinnaṁ saṁyati sāyakaiḥ ।chinnamātraṁ tu tacchīrṣaṁ punaranyat sma dṛśyate ।। 6.110.28 ।।

translations.english: Before cutting that second head of Ravana again another head appeared.
